full_text_en:
Dingbian County Plastic Products Factory v. Xianyang Branch Business Department of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China — Retrial of Dispute over Compensation for Tort

Petitioner: Dingbian County Plastic Products Factory, Shaanxi Province.
Legal Representative: Tian Haiying, Factory Director.

Respondent: Xianyang Branch Business Department of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Shaanxi Province.
Legal Representative: Wu Dingxiang, Director.

The Petitioner, Dingbian County Plastic Products Factory, Shaanxi Province, being dissatisfied with the final judgment of the Xianyang Intermediate People's Court of Shaanxi Province in the dispute over compensation for tort, filed a petition for retrial with the Shaanxi High People's Court. Upon review, the Shaanxi High People's Court found that the final judgment was indeed erroneous and on February 27, 1991, ruled to accept the case for retrial.

The Shaanxi High People's Court found the following facts upon retrial: In March 1988, the Dingbian County Plastic Products Factory (hereinafter referred to as "the Plastic Factory") requested assistance in purchasing polypropylene from a person who claimed to be an inspector sent by the Shaanxi Provincial Light Chemical Company and who went by the name "Zhang Jianping." "Zhang Jianping" agreed. On March 23, "Zhang Jianping" came to the Plastic Factory with a forged material allocation notice and a letter of introduction, stating that he could allocate 10 tons of polypropylene to the Plastic Factory from the polypropylene allocated by the Shaanxi Provincial Light Chemical Company to the Yangling District Plastic Products Factory of Xianyang, Shaanxi Province, at a price of RMB 48,000, and requested an immediate remittance and pickup. The Plastic Factory, concerned that the Yangling District Plastic Products Factory might not have the goods and that the remittance might be fraudulently obtained, discussed the remittance method with "Zhang Jianping" at the Dingbian County Sub-branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China. They decided to remit the funds by means of "to be collected by designated person upon arrival" (留行待取). On March 25, the Plastic Factory filled out a remittance voucher for RMB 48,000, with the remitter listed as Dingbian County Plastic Factory, Shaanxi Province, and the payee listed as "Liu Zhanbin (to be delivered upon arrival)" (刘占斌（留交）), and the purpose of remittance stated as "payment for goods." Based on this voucher, the Dingbian County Sub-branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China wired RMB 48,000 to the Xianyang Branch Business Department of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Shaanxi Province (hereinafter referred to as "the Xianyang Branch Business Department"). The telegram read: "To be delivered to Liu Zhanbin, RMB 48,000, payment for goods from Plastic Factory." Upon receipt of the remittance, the Xianyang Branch Business Department recorded it in the account. On March 30, a person holding a work card of "Yangling District Plastic Products Factory, Xianyang, Liu Zhanbin" and a private seal of "Liu Zhanbin" went to the Xianyang Branch Business Department to withdraw cash. After verifying the work card and private seal, the Xianyang Branch Business Department paid RMB 2,000 in cash as requested. On March 31, the Xianyang Branch Business Department, in addition to paying RMB 3,000 in cash as requested by "Liu Zhanbin," transferred the remaining RMB 43,000 into a personal savings account at the Renmin Road First Savings Sub-branch under the same bank, under the name of "Liu Zhanbin's private funds." On April 1, "Liu Zhanbin" withdrew the entire remaining amount from the savings sub-branch. On April 6, when the Plastic Factory's Liu Zhanbin went to the Xianyang Branch Business Department to collect the remittance, he realized that the remittance had been fraudulently withdrawn by another person. The Plastic Factory then filed a lawsuit with the Qindu District People's Court of Xianyang, Shaanxi Province.

The Plastic Factory alleged: The Xianyang Branch Business Department, by failing to strictly examine the documents of the person withdrawing the funds, caused the factory's public funds to be fraudulently withdrawn by another person, and thus should bear compensation liability. The Xianyang Branch Business Department argued: Since the payee on the remittance telegram was Liu Zhanbin, and there was no restriction that it was the Liu Zhanbin of the Plastic Factory, nor was it indicated that the funds were public funds, and there were no other special requirements, the payment was made in accordance with the withdrawal provisions for personal remittances after examining the withdrawing person's documents and private seal. There was no fault, and no compensation liability should arise. The cause of the fraudulent withdrawal was the Plastic Factory's lack of caution, having already disclosed the specific details of the remittance to others. The Plastic Factory was at fault and should bear the loss itself.

The Qindu District People's Court found upon trial: Article 10, paragraph 2 of the "Settlement Measures of the People's Bank of China" (hereinafter referred to as the "Settlement Measures") promulgated on November 6, 1977, provides: "If the remitting unit sends personnel to the receiving bank to collect the remittance, the words 'to be collected by designated person upon arrival' may be noted on the remittance authorization form." Paragraph 6 provides: "For procurement funds remitted into the receiving bank, the bank must, based on a certificate of approval for procurement from the relevant local department, open a procurement account in the name of the remitting unit, and supervise payment in accordance with relevant local market management regulations... Except for a small amount of cash that may be withdrawn for the travel expenses of procurement personnel, all payments shall be made by transfer." The remittance telegram from the Plastic Factory clearly indicated that RMB 48,000 was payment for goods from the Plastic Factory and requested that it be collected by the designated person, Liu Zhanbin, dispatched by the remitting unit, using the "to be collected by designated person upon arrival" method. After receiving the remittance, the Xianyang Branch Business Department handled a passbook for the payee's unit and required the payee to fill out a unit withdrawal voucher each time. The purpose column of these vouchers also stated "purchase of materials." These circumstances all confirm that the Xianyang Branch Business Department's defense that it was unaware the funds were public funds and thus paid in accordance with the withdrawal provisions for personal remittances, and therefore had no fault, was untenable. The Xianyang Branch Business Department violated the provisions of the Settlement Measures. Without the withdrawing person presenting any dispatch document from the remitting unit or any procurement certificate, and relying solely on the work card of "Yangling District Plastic Products Factory, Liu Zhanbin" held by the withdrawing person, it allowed two cash withdrawals totaling RMB 5,000 and transferred the remaining amount to a personal savings account, thereby creating conditions for the fraudulent withdrawal of the remaining cash. The Xianyang Branch Business Department was at fault. In accordance with Article 106, paragraph 2 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the Xianyang Branch Business Department should bear civil liability for the economic losses caused to the Plastic Factory due to its own fault. Accordingly, on August 12, 1988, the court ruled: The Xianyang Branch Business Department of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China shall compensate the Dingbian County Plastic Products Factory for the payment for goods of RMB 48,000; the Plastic Factory shall bear the interest loss on the payment for goods itself.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, the Xianyang Branch Business Department, dissatisfied, appealed to the Xianyang Intermediate People's Court of Shaanxi Province on the same grounds as its defense, and submitted an interpretation by the Accounting Department of the People's Bank of China regarding the provision of Article 10, paragraph 2 of the Settlement Measures concerning "to be collected by designated person upon arrival." The interpretation stated: "'To be collected by designated person upon arrival' refers to the remitting unit sending its own personnel directly to the receiving bank to handle the payment settlement procedures, and also refers to the remitting unit dispatching personnel at the receiving location to handle the payment settlement procedures at the receiving bank. When the receiving bank settles the payment, it should verify the identity document proving the payee's identity. If the remitter notes the payee's unit in the 'payee' column of the remittance voucher, the receiving bank shall verify the document indicating the payee's unit name, and then handle the settlement procedures."

The Xianyang Intermediate People's Court found upon trial: When the Plastic Factory made the remittance, it did not restrict the unit of the designated recipient Liu Zhanbin, making it impossible for the Xianyang Branch Business Department to verify whether the withdrawing person's documents corresponded to the restricted unit. When settling this remittance, the Xianyang Branch Business Department inquired about relevant circumstances from the withdrawing person, verified the identity documents held by the withdrawing person, noted the document number on the bank ledger page, and required the withdrawing person to sign and affix a seal. Only after confirming that the name used by the withdrawing person matched the name of the designated recipient in the telegram did it settle the payment. Based on the business scope of the savings sub-branch and the withdrawing person's request, the remaining funds were transferred to a savings account. The entire process of settling the remittance complied with the procedures. The Xianyang Branch Business Department had no fault. The responsibility for the fraudulent withdrawal of the remittance lay with the Plastic Factory. Accordingly, on June 9, 1989, the court rendered the second-instance judgment: 1. Set aside the first-instance judgment; 2. Dismiss the Plastic Factory's claims.

After the second-instance judgment was pronounced, the Plastic Factory, dissatisfied, filed a petition for retrial with the Shaanxi High People's Court.

The Shaanxi High People's Court found: When settling the purchase remittance of the Plastic Factory, the Xianyang Branch Business Department failed to strictly examine the documents that the withdrawing person should present, violating relevant provisions of the Settlement Measures, thereby causing the remittance to be fraudulently withdrawn by another person, and should bear compensation liability. The reasons are as follows: 1. According to Article 10, paragraph 2 of the Settlement Measures and the interpretation of that provision by the People's Bank of China, remittances designated as "to be collected by designated person upon arrival" refer both to cases where the remitting unit sends its own personnel directly to the receiving bank to handle settlement procedures, and to cases where the remitting unit dispatches personnel at the receiving location to handle settlement procedures at the receiving bank. Both situations require that the withdrawing person is dispatched by the remitting unit in order to settle the remittance. When settling a "to be collected by designated person upon arrival" remittance, the Xianyang Branch Business Department should not only verify the personal identity document of the person handling the settlement procedures, but should also request and verify evidence of whether the withdrawing person was dispatched by the remitting unit to handle the settlement procedures. However, the Xianyang Branch Business Department only verified the work card held by the withdrawing person, and the issuing unit of the work card was "Yangling District Plastic Products Factory," which was neither the remitting unit nor the payee unit entrusted by the remitting unit. Under circumstances where it could not prove that the withdrawing person was dispatched by the remitting unit to handle the settlement procedures, the Xianyang Branch Business Department's settlement of the remittance was improper. 2. When the Petitioner made the remittance, it had stated that the purpose of the funds was "purchase of goods." The Xianyang Branch Business Department failed to comply with Article 10, paragraph 6 of the Settlement Measures, which provides that for funds remitted to other places for purchasing goods, "except for a small amount of cash that may be withdrawn for the travel expenses of procurement personnel, all payments shall be made by transfer." Instead, it disbursed a large amount of cash, which was the main cause of the fraudulent withdrawal of the remittance. 3. In 1982, the People's Bank of China stipulated that public funds of state-owned and collective enterprises could not be deposited into savings accounts under any name. The Xianyang Branch Business Department, without proper examination and approval, transferred the Petitioner's wired public funds into a personal savings account, creating an opportunity for the fraudulent withdrawal, and its liability cannot be evaded. The Plastic Factory, due to its own negligence, also bears some responsibility. In accordance with Article 106, paragraph 2 of the General Principles of the Civil Law, which provides that "citizens and legal persons who, through their fault, infringe upon the property of the state or a collective shall bear civil liability," the Xianyang Branch Business Department shall bear primary liability, and the Plastic Factory shall bear secondary liability. Accordingly, on March 30, 1991, the Shaanxi High People's Court ruled:

1. Set aside the second-instance judgment of the Xianyang Intermediate People's Court.
2. Affirm the first-instance judgment of the Qindu District People's Court.
